dialogue.text:
Ophelia has decided to take an extended break
from shop duty.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
She'll be back someday,<d=0.25/> but until then
you'll have to deal with me.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text: Hopefully I won't be here for as long as she was.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
I bet she's sleeping in her office
for the billionth time...
dialogue.speaker: April
